title: StateDiff
description: What changed between two AccountState versions. is_material=false records 'no material state change'.

field.description: AccountState field name, 'buying_group' / 'coverage_gaps', or 'primary_opportunity_changed'. The last is emitted when the AccountState's primary opportunity (opportunity_id) differs between the two versions: before and after are the two opportunity ids (null for none), op is 'changed', and it is not material. In that diff the deal-scoped fields are NOT compared, because the headline then belongs to two different deals and a difference would be a false stage or champion change (ADR-0016); only the account-scoped fields, buying_group and coverage_gaps are.

opportunity_id.description: The deal a deal-scoped change belongs to; absent for account-scoped changes. The headline of an AccountState belongs to its primary opportunity.
